The Georg Arnhold Program at the Georg Eckert Institute (GEI) funds international research on education for sustainable peace, offering senior and early-career fellowships in Braunschweig, Germany. Each year's call, with its application window and award tracks, is published on the GEI application page.

Programme Highlights

  • Dedicated fellowship scheme on education, textbooks and sustainable peace
  • Residency at the world's leading institute for textbook research
  • Tracks for senior researchers and early-career scholars
  • Annual call with fixed application windows

Who Should Apply

Researchers in education, political science, history and related fields working on peace education, curriculum or textbook research.

Funding and Costs

Monthly stipend plus research support and travel for the fellowship stay at the Georg Eckert Institute.

Deadline and How to Apply

Follow the GEI application page for the current call and submit the research proposal in the requested format by the closing date. Key deadline information: Annual call — application window and closing date published on the GEI application page.

Official Link

  • Official application page (verified link)

About Georg Eckert Institute (GEI)

The Georg Eckert Institute for International Textbook Research in Braunschweig studies educational media worldwide and hosts the Georg Arnhold Program on education for sustainable peace.

Official website: https://www.gei.de

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: Annual call - see official page - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
